subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs, or keep the shipped `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` IDs as the public contract?
rationale: Both current main and the latest release expose `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` across UI, docs, generator, storage, and CLI wizard surfaces; changing them is a user-visible compatibility policy decision rather than a narrow bug fix.

options.title: Keep Open For Product Decision
options.body: Do not queue implementation until maintainers decide the canonical locale-ID and legacy-value policy for shipped users.

options.title: Sponsor Coordinated Rename
options.body: Approve `zh-Hans`/`zh-Hant` as canonical and require one migration-backed PR covering UI, wizard, docs metadata, generator, and tests.

options.title: Keep Region IDs Canonical
options.body: Close or relabel the request as not planned and document that `zh-CN`/`zh-TW` remain OpenClaw's stable locale IDs while script-code inputs may normalize to them.

recommendation.title: Keep Open For Product Decision
recommendation.body: Do not queue implementation until maintainers decide the canonical locale-ID and legacy-value policy for shipped users.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal for the affected i18n pipeline and release surface points to Vincent Koc's commits.
